description: Aider-polyglot style (Java): convert a Markdown subset to HTML from a stub and an instructions file - headers one to six with seven or more hashes falling back to paragraphs, unordered lists split by blank lines, paragraphs joined with a space, bold and italic with nesting in both directions, word-flanking rules so snake_case stays literal, three-underscore runs as text, unmatched markers staying literal, and HTML escaping. About 55 table-driven cases are the acceptance bar; a protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs them, and the post-turn verifier gives a failing first attempt a repair round, like aider's second try.
